name: replicate-video
description: Replicate predictions for video models (Veo, Kling, Hailuo, Wan, ...): run and wait with downloads, prediction status, model discovery

nodes.title: Run model
nodes.description: Run an official or latest-version model by owner/name, e.g. google/veo-3 or kwaivgi/kling-v2.1 (paid; waits and saves the video)

input.description: The model's input object, e.g. {"prompt": "...", "duration": 5}; see the model's API tab or get_model

cancel_after.description: Cancel automatically after this long, e.g. 20m (stops runaway billing)

wait.description: Wait for the job to finish (default true); false returns the job id at once

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
